title: Lynnphora Offer to Help

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Ok ok ok, I know this looks bad but I'm just really struggling to make this work. I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok ok ok, I know this looks bad but I'm just really struggling to make this work. I'm sorry.
Totally understand!

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: No, but really this time, I need to be rid of this urn, It's so hard to carry shopping with this damn thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, but really this time, I need to be rid of this urn, It's so hard to carry shopping with this damn thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are there any other details about Eugene that might inform your choice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are there any other details about Eugene that might inform your choice?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are there any other details about Eugene that might inform your choice?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are there any other details about Eugene that might inform your choice?

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Well, I was thinking the other day about how much he liked beef cubes. I tried them a few times but they were never really my thing. He never shut up about them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I was thinking the other day about how much he liked beef cubes. I tried them a few times but they were never really my thing. He never shut up about them.
I'd eat that.
They sounds gross.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: So maybe the greenhouses where they grow the synthetic meats might be most appropriate?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So maybe the greenhouses where they grow the synthetic meats might be most appropriate?
Sounds like a great idea.
Hmmmm, I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm worried you're gonna keep going in circles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm worried you're gonna keep going in circles.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm worried you're gonna keep going in circles.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm worried you're gonna keep going in circles.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Welcome to my silly life. I struggle to make a decision about which coffee to order so I fear we'll both be in urns before this is over. Maybe it's time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Welcome to my silly life. I struggle to make a decision about which coffee to order so I fear we'll both be in urns before this is over. Maybe it's time.
For what?

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Well since we started talking I have been thinking maybe it's time to let someone else make a call. Would you possibly take him? Eugene I mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well since we started talking I have been thinking maybe it's time to let someone else make a call. Would you possibly take him? Eugene I mean.
I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Oh I'm so sorry, I didn't mean for free or anything. I can pay you some Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh I'm so sorry, I didn't mean for free or anything. I can pay you some Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't help you if you won't help yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't help you if you won't help yourself.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can't help you if you won't help yourself.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can't help you if you won't help yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds frankly, horrible.
You're totally right. Awful idea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I'll do this for free.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I'll do this for free.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I'll do this for free.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I'll do this for free.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Show me some money.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Oh really? What a fantastic being you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh really? What a fantastic being you are.
Business is business!

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: No you're right. It's my own fault.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No you're right. It's my own fault.
It's time.
